| description = Handing the [[Astral Projection (LOIO)]] the [[Eye of Kaiaren]] spawns Vorash along with [[Deep]]. Upon death, [[Xenevorash]] spawns along the lake where Vorash originally spawned. Vorash will depop after 80 minutes as long as he isn't engaged. It's Nukeable.

The easiest way to kill Vorash and [[Xenevorash]] is to run them to the Cabilis guards. Simply spawn Vorash & Deep, tag them both and run them to Cabilis. The guards will kill both of them. You can optionally have someone kite Deep away altogether, only Vorash needs to die to spawn [[Xenevorash]].

Once Vorash dies, [[Xenevorash]] spawns back at the lake. Tag him and repeat. 

''Note: Do not let the guards kill [[Xenevorash]] as that will result in his corpse disappearing and you will be unable to loot [[Demon Fangs]]. Simply use the guards to get him low then finish him yourself. This can be done easily with 2 people.'' 

(April 29th, 2025) -- Tried the above described method of doing this solo. The guards -did- kill Vorash ... They will not attack or interact with [[Xenevorash]]. Ended up having to call in a bunch of friends to help.
